title: MorseEEG-ATP
description: MorseEEG-ATP is a multitask EEG dataset for investigating auditory temporal processing and temporal pattern discrimination using Morse code stimuli. It contains synchronously recorded EEG and behavioral data from 32 healthy adults performing two auditory discrimination tasks (dot-count and first-last match) across three presentation-rate conditions (15, 30, and 40 characters per minute). The dataset, organized in BIDS format, includes raw and minimally preprocessed EEG data, trial-aligned event annotations, behavioral measures, and analysis scripts to support research on temporal pattern discrimination and listening ability assessment.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 healthy adults (14 females) using a 62-channel g.tec g.HIamp system at a sampling rate of 600 Hz, with online bandpass filtering (0.1-100 Hz) and a 48-52 Hz notch filter. Electrodes were arranged according to the International 10-20 system, referenced to the right earlobe. Stimuli were presented and behavioral responses collected using E-Prime 3.0. Participants performed two Morse code-based auditory discrimination tasks (dot-count and first-last match) under three presentation-rate conditions. Data are organized in BIDS format with raw BrainVision files and minimally preprocessed derivatives, including interpolation of corrupted channels for select participants.
